mapper.insert: INSERT INTO linked_account (account_id, member_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_number, account_holder, connected_id, is_primary) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{memberId}, #{bankCode}, #{bankName}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountHolder}, #{connectedId}, #{isPrimary})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM linked_account WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE linked_account SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
